verifiedScope.proxy: Lifetime original-Swedish Moomin prose-book publication span from The Moomins and the Great Flood to Moominvalley in November; it is a selected publishing proxy, not a complete bibliography or claim of uninterrupted work.
workDates: 1945 — The Moomins and the Great Flood
verifiedScope.dateDistinctions: Markers use first Swedish-language book publication years in Finland rather than composition, revised editions or later translations; English titles are shown for readability. The Moomins and the Great Flood appeared in Swedish in 1945 and English in 2005. Comet in Moominland appeared as Kometjakten in 1946, was revised in 1956 and 1968, and reached English in 1951. Moominpappa at Sea appeared in Swedish in 1965 and English in 1966; Moominvalley in November appeared in Swedish in 1970 and English in 1971. The 1962 story collection Tales from Moominvalley is within the official nine-book series but omitted from this eight-marker selection. Picture books, comics, adult fiction, illustration and painting are outside this Moomin prose-book scope.
verifiedScope.influence: No claim of influence is inferred from chronological overlap.
